import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    k = p[0]
    e = np.exp(-k*t)
    return (p[1] + p[2]*P + p[3]*P**2
            + (p[4] + p[5]*P + p[6]*P**2)*e
            + (p[7] + p[8]*P + p[9]*P**2)*t*e)
